note: Populated by running the screen. Every member carries the filing that admitted it. This file is not complete and is not an index until the screen has run over the full NSE universe; see docs/india-ai-intelligence.md PART 9.

thresholds.normalAdvt: lower of the 20-day and 60-day median daily traded value
thresholds.note: Eligibility by thematic evidence; sizing by liquidity. There is no turnover floor, because every floor available was fitted to the seven companies in front of it. A company does not stop being an AI enabler because a given position is too large for it - it stops being able to carry that position, so the screen reports a maximum executable position instead of a pass or a fail. Target position set 2026-09-18 at Rs 100 crore, so a member needs Rs 166.67 crore of normal daily turnover (100 / (3 x 0.2)) to carry a full position. A member below that is still a member; it carries a smaller maximum position, reported beside it.

sizingExceptions.context: Listed on NSE 2026-03-02, so its turnover history is about six months long.

thresholds.sizingExceptionsNote: An exception removes a member from belowTarget; it does not change what the member can carry. Its maximum executable position and shortfall are still computed and reported beside it.

measuredLiquidity.note: Median daily turnover in rupees. Median, not mean: one block trade in a thin name moves a mean enough to carry it through a floor it does not clear.

dataAvailability.note: What the connected sources actually serve for these members, probed rather than assumed.
dataAvailability.freeFloatMarketCap: DERIVED and cross-checked. market cap = P/B x book equity, since P/B is price over book value per share and no share count is needed. P/B from Upstox key-ratios, equity from Upstox balance-sheet (standalone - consolidated returns no rows), promoter share from Upstox share-holdings, and an independent market cap from Yahoo to check it against. The basis is the exposed assumption: the equity is standalone while the P/B's basis is unstated, and for a holding company those books differ by a multiple. A member whose two figures disagree by more than 25% is reported unscreened rather than screened on a number nobody verified. Yahoo is a cross-check and never a source: if it is unreachable, every member is refused.
dataAvailability.stage3Inputs: Revenue growth yes, capex no. income-statement serves revenue, operating_profit and net_profit with four annual periods each, so a three-year CAGR has the points it needs. Capex is in neither the income statement nor the cash-flow statement: cash-flow serves operating, investing and financing, and its line items run from profit before tax to cash at the end of the year with nothing for purchases of property, plant or equipment. Investing cash flow is not a substitute - it nets acquisitions and disposals against capital spending, and for a holding company it is mostly stake buying, so it would be most wrong for exactly the companies where capex matters most. capex-to-sales and capex growth need an ingested filing.
dataAvailability.consensusEstimates: ABSENT. No forward estimates on any connected source, so earnings revisions and forward EPS have nothing to compute from.
dataAvailability.unblockedBy: Ingesting annual reports for the seven members. That single action supplies shares outstanding for Stage 2, capex and revenue with lineage for Stage 3, and the citations the dashboard claims resolve to.
dataAvailability.balanceSheet: Only standalone returns rows, and only total_asset and total_liability. Consolidated yearly, consolidated quarterly and the default parameters all return zero rows.
dataAvailability.crossCheckSource: Yahoo Finance quote endpoint, already used elsewhere in this repo. Reported in whole rupees and converted to crore once, in the provider - the statements it is compared against are in crore, and a missing factor of 1e7 would fail every company by seven orders of magnitude and read as 'the derivation is always wrong' rather than as a unit bug.
dataAvailability.ratioBasis: Resolved by measurement rather than assumed. P/E is price over earnings per share and income-statement's full_statement carries EPS - Basic on the requested basis, so dividing the live price by each basis's EPS and comparing against the stated P/E identifies which basis the key-ratios figures are quoted on. A P/E matching neither is reported as such rather than forced onto the nearer one, because it means the ratio is computed on something this code does not hold. That settles the assumption the size derivation previously carried unexamined.
dataAvailability.corporateActions: Available, and needed. A bonus or split halves or divides the quoted price on its ex-date, and against an unadjusted previous close the basket reads a loss that did not happen. The residual check does not catch this - the wrong member return flows into the contribution and the index return identically and they still reconcile - so the ex-dates are read ahead and the member is excluded for the day. A dividend is not flagged: the price falls by it and the holder received it, which is a real return.
dataAvailability.parameters: balance-sheet and cash-flow take type and fs only. income-statement additionally takes time_period. share-holdings, key-ratios and corporate-actions take none.
dataAvailability.disclosedFacts: Held in india-ai-enablers.disclosed-facts.json, provenance class THIRD_PARTY_RELAYED. Supplied in conversation citing aggregators rather than read from a primary filing by this system, so they carry a source but no document id, page or sentence. They are not served as FILED and are not in company_facts. Ingesting the annual reports either confirms or contradicts each one.
dataAvailability.exposureAttribution: A third dimension beside evidence and liquidity, in three tiers rather than two. SEGMENT_REPORTED: the theme is an audited Ind AS 108 segment, separable into revenue, result, assets and capex - CGPOWER only. MANAGEMENT_DISCLOSED: the company states a figure for the theme outside segment reporting - NETWEB's AI Systems at 43.4% of revenue, CLEANMAX's 42% of contracted capacity - specific and first-party, but unaudited as a segment and not tied to assets or capex. NOT_ATTRIBUTABLE: nothing separable - KAYNES reports one segment, ADANIENT's data centres sit in an equity-accounted joint venture, POWERINDIA has no AI line though its orders are individually sized. A binary verdict had put NETWEB beside KAYNES, which disclose very different amounts. Never used to drop a company automatically.
dataAvailability.unreadable: Form MGT-7 for 2024-25 was supplied and could not be read: it is an image-scanned PDF with no extractable text layer, and no OCR is available in this environment. It is also the prior year. Nothing from it has been recorded.
dataAvailability.emptyLayersAreAStandard: Checked against an independent screen of the same question, and the check is worth recording even though its figures are not. That screen used a materially lower bar for AI exposure - company mentions in news flow and management discussion, with partnerships counting as qualifying - and on that basis it placed companies in both of the sub-layers AGI reports empty. AGI had already examined those layers and refused what it found there: monomers being developed, technologies being evaluated, a capability claim with no segment split, a product-positioning slide. The same companies, judged against a different standard. So the two empty sub-layers are a finding about what Indian semiconductor materials and equipment companies currently disclose, not a gap in AGI's coverage - and that is now checked rather than assumed.
dataAvailability.taxonomyProvenance: The three layers and nine sub-layers were derived from published third-party research at the start of this build rather than arrived at independently. Recorded because an independent screen using the same decomposition is not corroboration of it, and nobody should later read the match that way.

universeScope.note: Companies on neither NSE equity list are outside the universe, whatever their evidence. They are kept in candidates with outOfUniverse set, so the reason they are absent stays visible.

externalLeads.description: 42 companies reported as named in a sell-side AI-enablers screen (17 September 2026).
externalLeads.source: Economic Times article, 2026-09-18, as relayed in a ChatGPT summary supplied by the analyst
externalLeads.verificationNote: AGI could not open the article (its fetch and browser are blocked for that site), so the list is recorded as relayed. The list served only as a reading queue: no layer, weight or score was taken from it, and every company was admitted, held or excluded on its own filings under AGI's evidence standard.

membershipNote: membershipStart is the date AGI decided the admission. It is not the date of the evidence, and discovering older evidence never creates earlier membership. Any performance series starts a member no earlier than this date.
